dossier.stage_and_modality: Clinical stage company developing in vivo CAR-T therapies with CD19 CAR-T program entering clinical development.
dossier.delivery_approach: In vivo CAR-T delivery platform technology.
dossier.key_differentiators: In vivo approach to CAR-T therapy, eliminating need for ex vivo cell manufacturing and patient-specific treatment preparation.
dossier.last_significant_event: Raised $122 million Series B financing in May 2026 and strengthened advisory board with three key appointments including autoimmune disease expert Georg Schett.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1/2 clinical stage with in vivo gene writing platform technology. Currently recruiting patients for alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency trial with TSRA-196.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Strongest preclinical data yet disclosed for in vivo sickle cell therapy as of May 2026. New preclinical data advancing both sickle cell disease and CAR-T applications presented at ASGCT 2026.
dossier.indications_pursued: Alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency with PiZZ genotype affecting lung and/or liver disease in clinical development. Sickle cell disease and CAR-T applications in preclinical development.
dossier.delivery_approach: In vivo gene writing platform that enables direct therapeutic genetic modifications without ex vivo cell manipulation.
dossier.key_differentiators: In vivo gene writing technology that challenges traditional ex vivo CAR-T approaches by enabling direct genetic modifications. Platform appears applicable across multiple disease areas from genetic diseases to CAR-T applications.
dossier.last_significant_event: May 2026 presentation of new preclinical data for sickle cell disease and CAR-T applications at ASGCT 29th Annual Meeting, described as strongest data yet for sickle cell program.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Preclinical stage company developing antigen-driven CAR-T (adCAR-T) expansion as an alternative to traditional ex vivo and in vivo CAR-T approaches.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Preclinical proof-of-concept data presented at ASGCT 29th Annual Meeting in May 2026.
dossier.delivery_approach: Antigen-driven CAR-T expansion method that bypasses manufacturing bottlenecks while avoiding systemic vector delivery risks.
dossier.key_differentiators: adCAR-T approach enables rapid, physiological CAR-T cell programming by using antigen-driven expansion rather than traditional ex vivo manufacturing or systemic in vivo delivery.
dossier.last_significant_event: Presented preclinical proof-of-concept data at ASGCT 29th Annual Meeting on May 12, 2026.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1 clinical stage company with an in vivo CAR-T approach using UB-VV111 for B-cell malignancies.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Currently conducting a Phase 1 dose-escalation and dose-confirmation study (NCT06528301) evaluating safety and antitumor activity of UB-VV111.
dossier.indications_pursued: Targeting B-cell hematologic malignancies including relapsed/refractory large B-cell lymphoma (LBCL) and chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL).
dossier.last_significant_event: Initiated recruiting for Phase 1 clinical trial NCT06528301 testing UB-VV111 in relapsed/refractory B-cell lymphomas.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1 clinical stage with asset CPTX2309, though specific in vivo delivery modality not disclosed in available data.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Currently recruiting healthy volunteers and rheumatoid arthritis patients in Phase 1 trial NCT06917742 for safety and tolerability assessment.
dossier.indications_pursued: Rheumatoid arthritis and systemic lupus erythematosus, focusing on moderate to severe disease presentations.
dossier.last_significant_event: Initiation of Phase 1 clinical trial NCT06917742 for CPTX2309 in autoimmune indications, currently in recruiting status.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1 clinical stage company developing in vivo CAR-T cell therapy. Currently recruiting patients in their first-in-human inMMyCAR study.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: 100% overall response rate (ORR) maintained in Phase 1 trial of KLN-1010, as presented at ASCO 2026. Multiple news sources highlighted this response rate as impressive for the in vivo CAR-T approach.
dossier.indications_pursued: Relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma. The lead asset KLN-1010 targets BCMA in this indication.
dossier.delivery_approach: In vivo BCMA CAR-T therapy platform. KLN-1010 delivers CAR-T functionality without ex vivo cell manipulation.
dossier.key_differentiators: In vivo delivery approach eliminates need for ex vivo T cell manufacturing. Early clinical data suggests strong durability profile for their in vivo CAR-T platform.
dossier.last_significant_event: ASCO 2026 presentation of updated Phase 1 data showing maintained 100% ORR after dosing additional patients, occurring June 1-2, 2026.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Early-phase clinical development with in vivo CAR-T delivery platform. Multiple Phase I trials recruiting or preparing to recruit across hematologic malignancies and autoimmune diseases.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Limited disclosed data available, with trials focusing on safety, tolerability and initial efficacy assessments. Most advanced trial (NCT07336823) is in early Phase I for relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma.
dossier.indications_pursued: Hematologic malignancies including multiple myeloma, B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia, and B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma. Also targeting refractory autoimmune diseases with CD19/BCMA dual targeting approach.
dossier.delivery_approach: Injectable in vivo CAR-T platform with lead assets JY231 for B-cell malignancies and JY232 for multiple myeloma. Dual CD19/BCMA targeting approach for autoimmune indications.
dossier.key_differentiators: Direct injection delivery method eliminating need for ex vivo cell manufacturing. Dual target approach with CD19/BCMA combination for autoimmune applications.
dossier.last_significant_event: Initiation of recruiting for early Phase I trial NCT07336823 testing JY232 in relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma patients.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1 clinical stage with two distinct assets (HN2301 and HN2302) targeting autoimmune diseases. Multiple ongoing trials with one terminated study.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: No disclosed clinical or preclinical data available from the trial records. All trials list outcomes as 'Not reported'.
dossier.indications_pursued: Autoimmune diseases including generalized myasthenia gravis, systemic lupus erythematosus, and scleroderma/systemic sclerosis. Focus on refractory forms of these conditions.
dossier.last_significant_event: Initiation of recruiting for Phase 1 trial NCT06801119 evaluating HN2301 in systemic lupus erythematosus and scleroderma patients.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Preclinical stage company developing non-viral in vivo CAR-T therapies.
dossier.delivery_approach: Non-viral in vivo CAR-T delivery platform technology.
dossier.key_differentiators: Focus on non-viral delivery mechanisms for in vivo CAR-T cell generation, distinguishing from viral-based approaches.
dossier.last_significant_event: Acquired Pantherna Therapeutics in June 2026 to accelerate clinical translation of their in vivo CAR-T pipeline.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1/2 clinical stage company with lead asset EN-374 in recruiting trials for X-linked chronic granulomatous disease.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: No clinical or preclinical efficacy data disclosed in available trial records.
dossier.indications_pursued: Primary focus on X-linked chronic granulomatous disease with EN-374. Previously pursued sickle cell disease and stem cell mobilization with terminated MGTA-145 program.
dossier.last_significant_event: Initiation of Phase 1/2 trial NCT06876363 for EN-374 in X-linked chronic granulomatous disease, currently recruiting patients.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1 clinical stage with in vivo CAR-T cell therapy platform. Currently has three active Phase 1 trials evaluating SC262 and SC291 assets.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Preclinical data for SG293 surrogate demonstrating cell-specific delivery, potent CAR T cell generation, and deep B cell depletion in non-human primates. Clinical data from ongoing Phase 1 trials has not been reported.
dossier.indications_pursued: Hematologic malignancies including non-Hodgkin's lymphoma, large B-cell lymphoma, and chronic lymphocytic leukemia. Also targeting autoimmune diseases including systemic lupus erythematosus.
dossier.delivery_approach: In vivo CAR-T cell therapy platform with cell-specific delivery mechanism. Multiple assets (SC262, SC291, SG293) suggest a modular platform approach.
dossier.key_differentiators: In vivo CAR-T generation eliminating need for ex vivo cell manufacturing. Hypoimmune cell therapy platform combined with in vivo CAR-T approach.
dossier.last_significant_event: May 2026 presentation of preclinical data for in vivo CAR T therapy SG293 showing potent CAR T generation and deep B cell depletion in non-human primates.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1-3 clinical development focused on small molecule therapeutics and intramuscular vaccination approaches, not in vivo CAR-T therapy.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Phase 3 completion of Nefecon study (NCT05534919) for IgA nephropathy in Chinese patients represents the most advanced clinical milestone.
dossier.indications_pursued: Kidney diseases including IgA nephropathy, primary membranous nephropathy, minimal change disease, and FSGS; oncology indications including squamous non-small cell lung cancer and solid tumors.
dossier.delivery_approach: Oral administration for BTK inhibitor EVER001 and intramuscular injection for cancer vaccine EVM14, with combination approaches using pembrolizumab and Ivonescimab.
dossier.key_differentiators: EVER001 is positioned as a highly selective, oral, reversible covalent BTK inhibitor with high kinase selectivity for proteinuric glomerular diseases.
dossier.last_significant_event: Completion of Phase 3 Nefecon study (NCT05534919) for IgA nephropathy, with multiple Phase 1/2 trials currently recruiting for both nephrology and oncology programs.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1 clinical stage company developing in vivo CAR-T therapies using circular RNA delivered via lipid nanoparticles targeting T cells.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Currently has two Phase 1 trials recruiting, including a safety study of ORN252 in healthy volunteers and a dose escalation study of TI-0032-III in autoimmune diseases.
dossier.indications_pursued: Targeting autoimmune diseases including systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) and Sjogren's syndrome with CD19-directed CAR-T therapy.
dossier.delivery_approach: Lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) that target T cells and encapsulate circular RNA encoding CD19 chimeric antigen receptor.
dossier.key_differentiators: Uses circular RNA technology for in vivo CAR-T generation rather than traditional linear mRNA or ex vivo cell manufacturing approaches.
dossier.last_significant_event: Company announced showcase of clinical-ready circular RNA in vivo CAR-T pipeline at 2026 ASGCT Annual Meeting in May 2026.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase I/II clinical stage company developing CAR-T cell therapies. Currently conducting three recruiting trials with OriCAR-017 for multiple myeloma and Ori-C101 for hepatocellular carcinoma.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Ori-C101 demonstrated 66.7% overall response rate in late-line hepatocellular carcinoma patients as reported at ASCO 2026. This represents the most advanced efficacy data disclosed by the company.
dossier.indications_pursued: Relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma with anti-GPRC5D CAR-T (OriCAR-017) and advanced hepatocellular carcinoma with GPC3-directed CAR-T (Ori-C101). Focus on hematologic and solid tumor malignancies.
dossier.delivery_approach: CAR-T cell therapy platform using modified T cell injections. OriCAR-017 targets GPRC5D and Ori-C101 targets GPC3 antigen.
dossier.key_differentiators: GPC3-targeting approach in hepatocellular carcinoma with reported best-in-class potential based on 66.7% ORR in late-line patients. GPRC5D targeting for multiple myeloma represents established but competitive approach.
dossier.last_significant_event: ASCO 2026 presentation showing 66.7% overall response rate for Ori-C101 in late-line hepatocellular carcinoma, positioning as potential best-in-class therapy.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase I/II clinical stage company developing ex vivo CAR-T cell therapies. Multiple assets in active clinical trials targeting solid tumors and hematologic malignancies.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: CT041 (anti-claudin18.2 CAR-T) has advanced to Phase II for gastric adenocarcinoma and pancreatic cancer with active but not recruiting trials. Zevorcabtagene autoleucel has progressed to Phase IV post-marketing studies for relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma.
dossier.indications_pursued: Primary focus on solid tumors including gastric adenocarcinoma, pancreatic cancer, and hepatocellular carcinoma. Also targeting relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma in hematologic malignancies.
dossier.delivery_approach: Ex vivo CAR-T cell manufacturing approach using autologous T cells. Products are manufactured outside the body and reinfused as engineered cellular therapies.
dossier.key_differentiators: Targeting claudin18.2 with CT041 for solid tumor applications, particularly gastric and pancreatic cancers. Commercial-stage zevorcabtagene autoleucel product for multiple myeloma with long-term follow-up studies planned.
dossier.last_significant_event: Initiation of CT011 Phase Ib trial for hepatocellular carcinoma patients at risk of recurrence after surgical resection, currently recruiting patients.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Multiple programs in clinical development with both in vivo (IMV101, IMV102) and ex vivo CAR-T (IMC002) approaches. The company has reached Phase 3 development with IMC002 for gastric adenocarcinoma.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Phase 3 trial (NCT07103668) evaluating IMC002 in CLDN18.2-positive gastric adenocarcinoma as third-line therapy. Multiple Phase 1 trials are recruiting across hematologic and solid tumor indications.
dossier.indications_pursued: Hematologic malignancies including B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma and multiple myeloma, plus solid tumors focused on CLDN18.2-positive digestive system cancers including gastric, pancreatic, and esophagogastric junction adenocarcinomas.
dossier.delivery_approach: Dual platform approach with in vivo CAR-T delivery (IMV101, IMV102) and traditional ex vivo manufactured autologous CAR-T cells (IMC002). IMC002 targets CLDN18.2 antigen in solid tumors.
dossier.key_differentiators: Combination of both in vivo and ex vivo CAR-T platforms within the same company. Focus on CLDN18.2-targeting for solid tumors with advanced Phase 3 development stage.
dossier.last_significant_event: Initiation of Phase 3 trial (NCT07103668) for IMC002 in CLDN18.2-positive gastric adenocarcinoma, representing the most advanced clinical program.
